""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Searching more tag types with regex patterns will increase completeness by finding functions in diverse structures # MECHANISM-1: Building on Program 1's confirmed strategy - broader tag search captures functions in non-standard HTML layouts # EXPECT-1: completeness > 0.38 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.375) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Extracting descriptions from multiple sibling levels will improve accuracy by finding better context # MECHANISM-2: Program 1 confirmed that nearby text extraction improves accuracy - trying parent and grandparent siblings captures more relevant descriptions # EXPECT-2: accuracy > 0.80 # RESULT-2: CONFIRMED (actual=0.8333333333333334) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") func_dict = {} # Use dict to deduplicate by name pattern = re.compile(r'\b([a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_.]*)\s*\(([^)]*)\)') # Search across many tag types (building on Program 1's successful strategy) search_tags = ['dt', 'code', 'pre', 'h1', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4', 'h5', 'div', 'span', 'li', 'td'] for tag in soup.find_all(search_tags): text = tag.get_text() # Find function patterns for match in pattern.finditer(text): name = match.group(1) # Filter out very short names and common words if len(name) < 2 or name.lower() in ['if', 'or', 'is', 'in', 'to', 'of', 'for', 'the', 'a', 'an']: continue if name not in func_dict: signature = match.group(0) desc = extract_description_multi_level(tag) func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature), } if len(func_dict) >= 25: break if len(func_dict) >= 25: break return list(func_dict.values())[:25] def extract_description_multi_level(element) -> str: """Extract description trying multiple sibling and parent levels.""" # Try immediate next sibling next_elem = element.find_next_sibling() if next_elem: text = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if text and len(text) > 15: return text[:200] # Try parent's next sibling if element.parent: next_elem = element.parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem: text = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if text and len(text) > 15: return text[:200] # Try grandparent's next sibling if element.parent.parent: next_elem = element.parent.parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem: text = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if text and len(text) > 15: return text[:200] # Try dd sibling for dt elements if element.name == 'dt': dd = element.find_next_sibling('dd') if dd: text = dd.get_text(strip=True) if text: return text[:200] return "No description found" def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Extract parameter information from a function signature.""" params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1).strip() if param_string: # Split by comma for part in param_string.split(","): part = part.strip() if part and part not in ["self", "cls", "...", "*", "**"]: # Extract name (before : or =) name = re.split(r'[=:]', part)[0].strip() if name and len(name) > 0: params.append({ "name": name, "type": "unknown", "default": None, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
